## What changes for you

- MdClip now decodes previewed and copied Markdown content strictly as UTF-8. Invalid UTF-8 content is not previewed or copied, and MdClip tells you to save the file as UTF-8. A leading UTF-8 BOM is omitted from previewed and copied content.
- The All Markdown Sources command now keeps the same file as a separate result in each Markdown Source when source folders are duplicated or nested, preserving the correct section, relative path, selection, preview, and actions.
- Help now separates ordinary issue reports from possible security vulnerabilities so vulnerability details are not posted publicly.

## Install or update

- MdClip v0.4.0 accepts Node.js `>=22.22.2` and npm `>=11.17.0`. If the active versions satisfy both ranges, keep them. Otherwise, install the Node.js version recorded in `.node-version` (`24.19.0`) and use its bundled npm before running `npm ci`.
- For a normal update, keep MdClip in Raycast, stop any old `npm run dev` process, replace only the old `mdclip` source folder with `Source code (zip)` from this release, then run `npm ci` and `npm run dev` in the new folder. Keep the configured Markdown Source folders unchanged. Follow the [English update guide](https://github.com/uchimanajet7/mdclip/blob/v0.4.0/docs/getting-started.md#8-update-mdclip) or [Japanese update guide](https://github.com/uchimanajet7/mdclip/blob/v0.4.0/docs/getting-started.ja.md#8-%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0%E3%81%99%E3%82%8B).
